scope: Supersedes conflicting prospective analysis details only. Original source, factor cells, sample counts, data boundaries, production and training holds unchanged.

axis_mapping.G2: For known gold, map actual predict() label to axis value even if other axis wrong. None is abstention, counts as incorrect for unconditional balanced accuracy. Report per-context 2x3 confusion (0,1,abstain), per-value coverage and answered-only accuracy (undefined if no answers), raw argmax axis accuracy separately. Gold HOLD excluded from semantic axes. Compare G2 and conditioned probe on identical evaluation rows; probe unconditional binary decision, no rejection threshold. Both pooled and 4 conditioned contexts per axis; pooled accuracy not substitute for contexts.

upper_bound.primary: For each conditioned pair of balanced known cells, group EVAL examples by exact sorted unique SHA256 bin indices (equivalent to exact normalized feature vector). Let n_g0,n_g1 be counts of each axis label per vector. U=sum_g max(n_g0,n_g1)/N; equal class sizes make this also balanced accuracy ceiling. If imbalance occurs, HOLD dataset audit; additionally formula weighted by 1/(2*N_label) for balanced accuracy. Report pooled axis U, full 9-class raw-accuracy U, separate known/HOLD balanced U with inverse-class frequencies, and matched-pair conflicts. Never group by cosine or Jaccard for deterministic bound.
upper_bound.decision: U<.80 in any conditioned context => COLLISION_LIMITED_ON_THIS_CONTEXT_AND_CORPUS regardless of probe. This precludes axis admission at 80% threshold on this finite corpus; not universal impossibility. U>=.80 necessary not sufficient. Retain original <1%,1–5%,>5% conflicting-row bands and strict <1% admission per context. U>=.80 and probe fails => PROBE_INCONCLUSIVE unless other integrity flags; possible nonlinear signal, distribution shift, data or solver limits. Nonlinear MLP only separate future diagnostic precommit, not automatic architecture change. U>=.80 and valid probe passes => linear signal accessible on tested distribution, G2 utilization determined separately.
upper_bound.near_collisions: Jaccard>=.8, Hamming distance and cosine>=.99 diagnostic distributions; no merging, no removal, no claim that near-collisions prove deterministic impossibility. Report NEAR_COLLISION_BURDEN descriptive only.

probe.solver: sklearn LogisticRegression, L2, lbfgs, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-8, fit_intercept=false, float64, random_state=381801; 9-way multinomial and conditioned binary models; class_weight=None except known/HOLD balanced; pin sklearn/numpy/scipy and Python versions before execution.
probe.selection: Keep C=1 fixed for primary comparability and avoid extra hyperparameter search, not asserted optimal. 5-fold grouped CV within TRAIN as validation diagnostic only, groups=preassigned family clusters, all counterfactuals together, balanced per-cell composition verified, deterministic group assignment with seed381801. Report fold scores, mean and SD, full TRAIN accuracy and untouched EVAL accuracy, identical balanced-accuracy definition per task. No C selection on EVAL or historical exam; future tuned C requires separate precommit and fresh evaluation. Convergence warnings invalidate associated fit for admission.
probe.gap: TRAIN minus EVAL balanced accuracy >.15 => GENERALIZATION_GAP_HOLD; report train/CV/EVAL differences and distribution-shift possibility. Does not prove overfit; block positive admission even if point metric passes. Negative U proof unaffected. Fixed fit C justified as reproducible regularized probe; no claim chance-like result exhausts linear classifiers.
probe.curve: 15,30,45,60 nested TRAIN family counts fixed seed381801; 5 grouped folds per count, full fit on respective subset, EVAL for descriptive comparison only, mean/SD CV error bars; no adaptive selection. If groups too few or fold infeasible report HOLD. Historical 27 EXAM run as secondary exposed historical check after primary outputs frozen; not blind, no fitting/tuning on these rows.
probe.hold: Separate binary known/HOLD with balanced class weights and balanced accuracy, separate G2 argmax16 vs argmax-known below .65 refusal mechanisms; report confusion and coverage, not semantic-axis average. No claim of general novelty detection.

generator.method: Deterministic authored grammatical templates, no LLM-generated rows during execution, no external corpus. Template manifest authored before scores; human/independent reviewer semantic check required before fit. One family = distinct lexical/syntactic construction cluster containing exactly one realization per 8 known labels and two matched unsupported relation texts, 10 rows per family. A family is not a synonym substitution or adverb variation of another; group near-duplicate construction variants under same cluster; if merged clusters reduce counts, HOLD not fill after results. Counterfactuals differ only target semantics, grammatical edits allowed; HOLD matched for length/structure, no class-ID or family tokens.
generator.split: 90 families preassigned 60 TRAIN/30 EVAL by disjoint construction clusters; held-out constructions, stratified by predeclared broad grammar strata, deterministic seeded assignment within strata (seed381801), no outcome-informed split. Freeze strata quotas and exact template roster before generating texts; 600/300 unchanged. Audit lexical cue overlap, length distributions and lexical-only baseline; same-author template study, no independent natural-language claim.
generator.dedup: Compare all new normalized texts with historical 54 attempted +27 exam (36 retained subset), union of approved forbidden normalized SHA256, cross split, and within corpus. Normalized exact duplicates prohibited; token Levenshtein similarity 1-distance/max(token counts)>=.85 or set-of-token-bigrams Jaccard>=.8 flags manual blind semantic/construction review. Do not delete within-family intended counterfactuals. Cross-split shared construction cluster forbidden, reassign entire cluster before corpus freeze or HOLD. No guarantee semantic dedup exhaustive. Exact feature conflicts retained. Record original synthetic authorship, generator version, rights/license declaration (no external sources claimed), template ID, cluster ID, label, per-row normalized SHA256, canonical UTF8 sorted-key compact JSON corpus SHA256, split manifest hash, historical source hashes. Freeze generator, roster, audit, counts and hashes before first probe/G2 score; missing review or corpus hash blocks execution.

statistics.scope: Exploratory diagnostic, not confirmatory population inference; no nominal family-wise claim. To make engineering admission conservative, for 12 conditioned axis contrasts plus one HOLD binary probe use Bonferroni alpha=.05/13 for one-sided family-bootstrap lower bounds; fixed 10000 resamples by family seed381802, lower quantile .05/13; report ordinary 95% intervals as descriptive too. 30 eval families small and bootstrap approximate, no guarantee FWER exact. Point BA>=.8, adjusted lower bound>.5, conflict<.01, U>=.8, convergence and gap gates all required for each semantic contrast. HOLD independently report BA>=.8 and adjusted lower bound>.5 with same integrity gates; no semantic average. G2 high defined unconditional balanced accuracy>=.8 per same context, low otherwise, no confidence claim. Missing/invalid metric=>UNDETERMINED.

priority: PROBE_INCONCLUSIVE if probe fails remaining gate

cases.G2_high_probe_low: PROBE_G2_DISAGREEMENT; check solver, training-domain mismatch, confounds and sampling; neither G2 overfit nor representational failure inferred

diagnoses.note: High pooled results cannot hide failed conditioned contrast. 3/3 semantic axes required for original domain, HOLD separate. Any narrowing requires new explicit label semantics and precommit, fresh eval, no automatic training.
